scientific_integrity: An all-parameter combinatorial argument establishes the stated formula; finite direct-substring checks are corroboration only. This analysis has not received an independent mathematical audit or external certification.
scientific_limitations: The exact formula holds for finite binary words containing at most three ones, not arbitrary sparse counts. Fixed-length extremizers are asserted within three-one words. The four shortest length-eight defective binary words and the unrestricted minimum-length defect theorem were previously known. Incomplete full-text access to some later literature leaves a historical-priority risk.
title: Exact palindromic defect and richness at binary weight three
